context.broader_goal: Make checkout retries safe so customers do not receive duplicate orders.
context.motivations: Support reports suggest retries after a timeout can create a second order.
context.constraints: Keep the public API stable. This lane is read-only. Do not access production or customer data.
context.decision_rationale: Trace existing request IDs before choosing storage for idempotency keys; reuse is preferable if the lifecycle fits.
context.intended_outcome: A grounded choice of where to enforce idempotency, with fewer duplicate orders and no API break.
context.delegation_purpose: Map the retry and order-creation paths so the main agent can design the implementation.

exclusions: Credentials, production systems, unrelated modules, and all implementation changes.

task.assignment: Trace retry entry points through order creation and identify existing request IDs. Find every caller inside the read scope.
task.expected_output: A Markdown call-path map plus JSON observations, evidence, uncertainties, and recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Name the scoped entry points and order-creation functions with file/line evidence.
Explain the lifetime of any existing request ID and state coverage gaps.

inputs.snapshot: Replace with the actual starting commit and dirty/untracked state.
inputs.content_or_path: Replace with relevant project conventions, file paths, and observed retry behavior.
